A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><img src=\"a.svg\" alt=\"A\"> <a href=\"/1\">x</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/3\">z</a></td></tr></table>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
